requirements.requirement: Core local playback shall work offline without an app account.
requirements.acceptance: fresh guest session imports and mixes two authorized local tracks in airplane mode.

requirements.requirement: Import shall use user-selected files/folders and retain durable access or make a verified local copy.
requirements.acceptance: restart, moved file and revoked access produce correct available/missing states without lost metadata.

requirements.requirement: Supported formats shall be enumerated by codec/container/bit depth/sample rate, initially evaluating MP3, AAC/M4A, WAV, AIFF, FLAC, Ogg/Vorbis and Opus.
requirements.acceptance: approved corpus decodes correctly; malformed/unsupported files fail safely. Final format set follows G1 decoder/license review.

requirements.requirement: Search shall filter title, artist, album, BPM range, key, tags, availability and played state.
requirements.acceptance: exact fixtures return expected results; search remains usable during playback on the declared library-size tier.

requirements.requirement: Crates/playlists, folders, smart rules, ratings, colors, comments, favorites and history shall support set preparation.
requirements.acceptance: reorder, rename, duplicate detection and saved filter behavior survive restart.

requirements.requirement: BPM, downbeat, key, waveform and loudness analysis shall run outside the real-time callback and cache versioned results.
requirements.acceptance: analysis progress/error is visible; playback does not depend on completed optional analysis.

requirements.requirement: Variable-tempo beatgrids and phrase/energy hints shall distinguish detected results from user corrections.
requirements.acceptance: live-drumming/tempo-change fixtures retain meaningful bar positions; low-confidence results are not presented as certain.

requirements.requirement: Users shall correct downbeats, beat positions, local tempo, half/double BPM and grid alignment, then lock edits.
requirements.acceptance: loops and sync follow corrected maps; reanalysis cannot overwrite locked edits silently.

requirements.requirement: Overview and detailed waveforms shall be derived from media, with cue/loop/grid overlays and explicit zoom.
requirements.acceptance: transient positions match reference audio; overview seeking and display clocks stay consistent.

requirements.requirement: Each deck shall provide load, play/pause, stop, temporary cue, nudge, position and elapsed/remaining time.
requirements.acceptance: independent state and multi-touch transport actions produce documented audible results.

requirements.requirement: Each track shall support at least eight named/color-coded hot cues plus saved memory markers.
requirements.acceptance: cues persist, trigger at intended musical positions and distinguish set/delete/trigger actions.

requirements.requirement: The engine shall support four deck identities; four simultaneous decks shall be enabled only for a certified workload tier.
requirements.acceptance: switching focus never changes transport or assignment; four-deck workload passes performance gates.

requirements.requirement: Touch jog/scratch shall support vinyl mode, nudge, directional movement and defined release behavior.
requirements.acceptance: scratch/release tests measure audio response; pointer cancellation cannot leave a deck held.

requirements.requirement: Waveform seek/scrub shall be a first-class action distinct from jog scratching.
requirements.acceptance: precise seek, coarse navigation and accidental-gesture protection work with track running or paused.

requirements.requirement: Tempo, pitch bend, key lock and independent key shift shall expose ranges and reset controls.
requirements.acceptance: reference playback verifies pitch/time behavior and smooth parameter changes across the approved range.

requirements.requirement: Manual matching and optional sync shall coexist with visible leader/follower and phase state.
requirements.acceptance: sync off returns predictable manual control; invalid grids cannot silently force a bad alignment.

requirements.requirement: Quantization shall support selectable musical resolution with explicit enabled state.
requirements.acceptance: cue, loop and pad commands meet the documented event scheduling rule; unquantized commands are not delayed to a beat.

requirements.requirement: Manual/auto loops, loop in/out, reloop, loop roll, beat jump and saved loops shall be supported.
requirements.acceptance: boundaries, negative jumps, track edges and changing-tempo maps are exercised without invalid reads.

requirements.requirement: Slip and reverse shall preserve or replace timeline position exactly as the chosen mode specifies.
requirements.acceptance: scratch/loop/cue during slip returns to the calculated musical position; release is click-controlled.

requirements.requirement: Mixer shall include trim, channel faders, EQ/isolator, filter, assignable crossfader sides/bypass and curve/cut-in.
requirements.acceptance: signal-path tests verify gains, bypass, center behavior, resets and audible smoothness.

requirements.requirement: Channel/master metering, peak hold, clipping indication and master protection shall reflect the actual signal.
requirements.acceptance: calibrated fixtures exercise overload; meter location and limiter latency are documented.

requirements.requirement: Independent cue/PFL, cue/master blend and headphone gain shall work only on valid output routes.
requirements.acceptance: isolated cue never leaks to main; split-mono mode clearly trades stereo for independence.

requirements.requirement: Route setup shall identify main/cue channels, sample rate and unsupported combinations.
requirements.acceptance: connect/disconnect/reconfigure on supported hardware yields truthful routes and safe fallback.

requirements.requirement: FX shall offer essential echo, delay, reverb and filter plus advanced modulation/distortion, assignment, wet/dry and tempo/free rate.
requirements.acceptance: impulse/reference tests verify routing, bypass and tails; no timing depends on UI frame rate.

requirements.requirement: FX XY control and macros shall show parameter mapping, hold/latch mode and reset behavior.
requirements.acceptance: two-axis gestures, multi-touch and cancellation map predictably; reset cannot leave hidden wet gain.

requirements.requirement: Performance pads shall have explicit cue, loop, roll, jump, slicer, sampler, pitch-play and stem modes where supported.
requirements.acceptance: changing bank/mode cannot trigger a hidden action; active mode and deck remain legible.

requirements.requirement: Sampler/sequencer supports at least 16 slots, banks, trigger modes, editable step patterns, per-step velocity/mute, length/resolution, swing and quantized start/stop/change.
requirements.acceptance: Saved banks/patterns survive restart; repeated sequences, tempo changes, bar-boundary edits, mute/stop and takeover follow engine time.

requirements.requirement: Prepared stems shall support aligned vocals/drums/bass/other with mute/solo/gain and readiness status.
requirements.acceptance: sum/alignment reference, cache integrity and unavailable-stem fallback are verified on authorized media.

requirements.requirement: Live separation shall be conditional on source permission, model license and measured device capacity.
requirements.acceptance: refused activation is understandable; overload does not disrupt already playing full-mix audio.

requirements.requirement: Microphone/aux input shall expose permission, route, gain, mute, monitoring and talkover/ducking.
requirements.acceptance: feedback-aware defaults and supported input/output latency are verified on actual hardware.

requirements.requirement: Mix recording shall provide format choice, timer, storage estimate, markers, safe finalization and partial recovery.
requirements.acceptance: low storage/process interruption recover valid segments; playback remains independent of writer failure.

requirements.requirement: Queue/automix shall show next readiness, transition settings, reorder, skip, cancel and immediate manual takeover.
requirements.acceptance: unavailable next track is never treated as ready; takeover causes no surprise transport restart.

requirements.requirement: Preview and track preparation shall remain available while the current set plays.
requirements.acceptance: browsing/search/editing never obscures required transport, output and fader access.

requirements.requirement: Session state shall persist deck assignments, cues, relevant controls, queue and history at defined checkpoints.
requirements.acceptance: recovery presents a truthful saved state and requires deliberate audible resume after a crash.

requirements.requirement: Live protection shall prevent unintended audible-deck replacement and destructive reset.
requirements.acceptance: load protection, live lock, quick fade and escape actions are tested under realistic touch errors.

requirements.requirement: Source capability resolution shall gate analysis, caching, DSP, stems, recording, export and broadcast independently.
requirements.acceptance: unknown/expired permission fails closed; provider restrictions are enforced below the UI.

requirements.requirement: Background playback, audio focus and interruption behavior shall be explicit per operating system.
requirements.acceptance: calls, notifications, lock screen, route loss and system termination follow approved state transitions.

requirements.requirement: Day/night, high contrast, reduced transparency/motion and color-independent identities shall be supported.
requirements.acceptance: critical controls and labels remain usable in each mode; screen-reader/precise-value alternatives exist.

requirements.requirement: Portrait/landscape and compact/expanded layouts shall preserve engine state and pointer safety.
requirements.acceptance: rotate during playback/gesture without audio reset, cue leakage or unintended fader movement.

requirements.requirement: Accounts shall be optional for the offline core; cloud functions shall disclose the data they require.
requirements.acceptance: expired app login cannot disable authorized local performance unexpectedly.

requirements.requirement: Backup/export shall include portable metadata, version information and explicit source references.
requirements.acceptance: round-trip restoration restores user work; restricted media is not copied as a side effect.

requirements.requirement: Diagnostics shall show meaningful audio-route, storage, battery/thermal and source readiness states.
requirements.acceptance: simulated faults produce actionable messages; telemetry omits track contents/tokens by default.

requirements.requirement: Bundled audio, fonts, icons, textures and models shall have documented rights and source versions.
requirements.acceptance: every shipped asset resolves to an approved manifest entry and required attribution.

requirements.requirement: Provider loss shall not invalidate the local engine, user-owned library or metadata unnecessarily.
requirements.acceptance: provider unavailable/revoked while local decks play leaves those local workflows operational.

requirements.requirement: Selected authorized video mixing with audio-clock synchronization, protected output and explicit mobile codec/display profiles.
requirements.acceptance: Pass functional case plus applicable AV cases on named device/format/workload; see specialist specification.

requirements.requirement: Selected karaoke and broadcasting, each with separate media/rights, mic/output, encoding and failure contracts.
requirements.acceptance: Pass functional case plus applicable AV cases on named device/format/workload; see specialist specification.

requirements.requirement: Selected actual third-party Android-compatible plugin hosting; lighting excluded; built-in FX alone insufficient.
requirements.acceptance: Pass functional case plus applicable AV cases on named device/format/workload; see specialist specification.
requirements.owner_and_first_gate: Architecture + Audio + Security / G1, G4, G6

requirements.requirement: ParDay provides selected preparation plus explicitly armed assisted performance, with typed proposals, deterministic local authority, immediate manual takeover and protected live audio.
requirements.acceptance: Pass AI-001 through AI-024 and shared gates.
requirements.owner_and_first_gate: AI + Product + Security + Audio / G2, G5, G6

requirements.requirement: Provide requested in-app Spotify/YouTube link-to-file acquisition, including unofficial adapter/extractor candidates, preserving exact media identity and provenance with separate technical, provider-access, content-rights and distribution statuses.
requirements.acceptance: Pass SRC-01 through SRC-12, DLA-01 through DLA-20 and the mapped shared gates.
requirements.owner_and_first_gate: Integrations + Data + Security / G2, G5, G6
requirements.cloud_acceptance_applicability: Only when the AWS extension is evaluated; does not gate initial local design or release.

delivery_sequence.complete_product: All selected professional modules remain in scope; an intermediate two-deck milestone is not full-product completion.
